Name: Haywrite's All-In-One Dialogue Expansion
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Tiakall had the idea I should combine all the Haywrite mods into an all-in-one configurable packag, so I've gone ahead and done that! You can now install and turn on/off the dialogue edits you want. The dialogue edits included are for:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1067]Clint[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1120]Demetrius[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1250]Dwarf[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1144]Gus[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1250]Krobus[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1488]Linus[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1192]Marnie[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1978]Pam[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1047]Willy[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1309]Wizard[/url]

Just toggle which ones you want with GMCM

Enjoy!
